ValidationRule.description: For restricting the contacts creation for Non frequent flyers, from case record page. For restricting modify firstName, LastName for Non frequent flyers.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( OR( $Profile.Name = "Qantas CC Consultant", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Hobart", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Manila", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Capetown", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Suva", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Auckland", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Mumbai" ), RecordType.DeveloperName =='QCC_Individual_Contact', OR(ISBLANK( Frequent_Flyer_Number__c ), ISNULL(Frequent_Flyer_Number__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c , 'Non-tiered')) ), AND( OR( $Profile.Name = "Qantas CC Consultant", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Hobart", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Manila", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Capetown", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Suva", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Auckland", $Profile.Name = "QCC Contact Center Agent Mumbai" ), RecordType.DeveloperName =='QCC_Individual_Contact', AND( OR(ISBLANK( Frequent_Flyer_Number__c ),ISNULL(Frequent_Flyer_Number__c )), ISPICKVAL(Frequent_Flyer_Tier__c , 'Non-tiered'), NOT( ISNEW() ), OR(ISCHANGED( FirstName ), ISCHANGED(LastName ) ) ) ) )
